_howto: To add an opener: python src/crop_openers.py <teamfight.lol screenshot> public/openers/img/opener-NN.webp (crops to the occupied hexes), then add an entry below with its pixel size (w, h). Champion names must match the game (e.g. "Kha'Zix", "LeBlanc"). traits = active traits as [name, count]. comps: S = direct comps, A = other comps to play (bunnymuffins.lol/openers). broken = a Broken Openers rule this board meets (red border). tier: ranked by strength from the source notes (red border = broken, independent of tier). tip: one-line paraphrase of the source notes. Source credited in the page footnote.

openers.name: Riftbeast Gromp
openers.tip: Fairly flexible: Gromp holds AD or AP items, and Scuttle Crab matters as much as Gromp.

openers.name: Kha'Zix Orb
openers.tip: Strong early and holds almost any AP item — a slam gets him an evolution in stage 2.

openers.name: 2 Ravager + Frontline
openers.tip: Very premium. Akali holds AP items, Camille AD; the frontline can be any upgraded 2-cost. Enough Akali copies → Solar Akali.

openers.name: 2 Hunter + Frontline
openers.tip: Cinderling holds AD caster items, Caitlyn holds on-hit (Guinsoo's). Prefer a 3 Riftbeast frontline.

openers.name: 3 Sprykin
openers.tip: Strong if you find Teemo. Don't feed Blackthorn unless Rek'Sai is your itemized tank.

openers.name: 4 Ravager
openers.tip: Win-streak opener: Akali/Diana hold AP, Camille/Murkwolf AD. Falls off around the stage 3 carousel.

openers.name: Rengar Orb
openers.tip: Tempo + econ. Give Rengar casting, AD or tank items. Found Master Yi? → Adaptor Reroll.

openers.name: 3 Blossom + 2 Juggernauts
openers.tip: A good default for fast 8 (upgraded Wisps). Lots of Karma/Yorick/Yunara copies → Solar Yunara.

openers.name: 2 Spellweaver + Frontline
openers.tip: The frontline decides your traits — swap to 3 Elderwood, or Yorick + a Juggernaut for 3 Blossom.

openers.name: Elderwood Rapidfires
openers.tip: Slow damage, so it needs a strong frontline. Xayah wants Guinsoo's, Varus wants Shojin.
